newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed sharply lower on Friday, as local investors actively sold the contracts due to the weaker Chicago market overnight, traders said.
The July, September and November fell by their daily 500 yen limit by the close, and the benchmark March 1998 contract was down 410 yen at 15,930 yen per tonne.

Active selling by individual investors emerged from the opening, reflecting price losses on the CBOT corn market, traders said. "Some individual investors were looking for the right time to liquidate their long positions. The yen's fall failed to change sentiment," a brokerage house trader said.
